name: sol-mascot
description: SOL — the Forward Deployed Business Analyst mascot, built from Unicode Block Elements and exported as PNG, GIF and MP4.

scripts.render: node scripts/render.mjs --input mascots/sol.html --name sol --out assets --selector .stage --width 600 --height 600 --fps 15 --duration 5200 --scale 2 --hero 12 --formats png,gif,mp4
scripts.render:png: node scripts/render.mjs --input mascots/sol.html --name sol --out assets --selector .stage --fps 15 --duration 5200 --hero 12 --formats png
scripts.build: npm run check && npm run render
